message: No detected untrusted source handling: All data sources are local file paths; there is no remote fetching, and no checksum or integrity verification is implemented anywhere in the visible code.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only validates dataset and task names against allowed string values but never checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks on training samples, or any filtering of suspicious inputs in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code references loading a model via `args.restoreModel` and `load_model_path`, and constructs a TransformerEncoder, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision applied to any loaded weights or serialized model artifacts.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses class_weights in the loss function, indicating awareness of class imbalance, but there is no explicit validation or check of label distribution or anomalous samples before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no evidence of any backdoor or trigger detection mechanism such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library or mechanism (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or referenced anywhere in the visible code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress-testing logic anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/validation/test split files are referenced, there is no hashing, signing, or isolation enforcement of the test set, nor any mechanism to detect or prevent metric manipulation.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the provided slice checks model output probabilities for NaN, out-of-range values, or applies calibrated thresholds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an NER/ABSA transformer-based pipeline, not an LLM, and no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or content moderation is present.
